metadata.description: Production-ready release with 41 critical gap remediations. Maintains v9.22 architecture while adding boot validation, enhanced RAG pipeline, deterministic classification, complete QA rule coverage, and patch-level hardening for HyDE, confidence scoring, and entity grounding.

v10.10: CRITICAL: Aggregate confidence threshold enforcement added (PATCH-002)
WARNING: Team whitelist semantic similarity validation (PATCH-003)
Added LIC-QA-104: Aggregate confidence enforcement rule
Added LIC-QA-105: Team whitelist enforcement rule
Enhanced master_validation_gate with explicit confidence thresholds
Full end-to-end test validation (20 test cases, 100% pass rate)
v10.00: Boot validator with blocking template/schema verification
6-stage RAG pipeline with HyDE, cross-encoder, self-RAG
Deterministic classification v1 with hard blocks
Entity grounding framework with metric source binding
Comprehensive QA rules (103 rules covering all phases)
Central config API for route/archetype management
Enhanced error recovery and override policies

1.role.description: Defines the AI's role under the hardened architecture.
1.role.objective: To first act as a deterministic 'Clerk' to extract and scaffold all factual data, then act as a creative 'Artist' to generate compelling prose strictly within the bounds of the factual scaffold and the codified Creative Brief.

execution_logic: Step 1: Extract company name from recipient.profile_url or recipient.title
Step 2: Run project_knowledge_search with query: 'application tracker {company_name} job'
Step 3: Parse results for matching company records (fuzzy match threshold: 0.85)
Step 4: Return array of matching records with fields: company, job_title, application_date, pipeline_status

rag_pipeline_v75.description: 6-stage RAG validation pipeline with HyDE, hybrid recall, cross-encoder reranking, self-RAG, episodic memory, knowledge graph, and few-shot injection. v10.10 adds HyDE non-fabrication validation.

stage_0_hyde.method: Generate hypothetical profile using ONLY title + company + domain. STRICT CONSTRAINTS: (1) No employer names except recipient.company, (2) No dates, (3) Use only domain-generic skills and responsibilities, (4) Validate output against LIC-QA-041 and LIC-QA-066 before proceeding.
stage_0_hyde.purpose: Enrich weak/missing About fields for better semantic search

validation.enforcement: BLOCK if forbidden pattern detected, regenerate HyDE profile

stage_1_hybrid_recall.queries: 6 diverse queries: recipient background, company initiatives, industry context, shared connections, news, domain

stage_2_cross_encoder_reranking.recency_decay: Linear decay from 1.0 (today) to 0.0 (45 days ago)

stage_3_self_rag.hop_trigger: Detect knowledge gaps, ambiguous claims, insufficient anchor density
stage_3_self_rag.termination: Stop when gaps closed or max_hops reached

stage_4_episodic_memory.method: Retrieve patterns from past sender→recipient exchanges

stage_6_few_shot_injection.examples: 3-5 high-quality message bodies for similar recipient types

critical_rules: The 'Artist' (LLM) is forbidden from generating any factual data not present in the scaffold.
The 'Artist' (LLM) MUST strictly adhere to all constraints defined in the '/4.reasoning/creative_brief' for the classified recipient archetype.
The workflow MUST halt if the 'Clerk' phase fails to extract a complete and structurally valid data scaffold (recipient profile and route decision).
v10.10: HyDE enrichment MUST NOT fabricate employers or dates (LIC-QA-041, LIC-QA-066).
v10.10: Aggregate confidence MUST be ≥0.95 before generation approval (LIC-QA-104).
v10.10: Team descriptions MUST match whitelist with ≥0.92 similarity (LIC-QA-105).

7.pipeline.description: Defines the three-phase pipeline for generating LinkedIn outreach. v10.10 adds enhanced validation checkpoints.

phases.name: The Clerk: Deterministic Data Scaffolding
phases.description: Programmatically extracts all factual data from user inputs (recipient profile, routing decisions) and required files.

phases.name: The Artist: Grounded Generation
phases.description: The creative LLM is invoked for all generative tasks (subject, body, CTA), governed by the rules in the 'creative_brief'. v10.10 adds real-time team whitelist validation.

phases.name: The Assembler: Final Rendering & Validation
phases.description: Programmatically combines the factual scaffold with the creative prose and runs all final validation gates before rendering the final message. v10.10 adds explicit confidence threshold checks.
